create_BadWordsState: create a BadWordsState instance to manage bad word token filtering for GPU-based LLM sampling requests
add_request_bad_words: add bad word token IDs from SamplingParams to a BadWordsState for a specific request index with offset validation
apply_staged_writes_bad_words: apply staged GPU writes for bad word token IDs, offsets, and counts from CPU to device memory
apply_bad_words: apply bad word filtering to logits by zeroing out token probabilities that match forbidden word sequences
review_bad_words_kernel: review the triton kernel that matches bad word prefixes against generated tokens and masks matching logits with -inf
